answer_readout.method: argmax restricted to standalone digit-token logits

bridge.architecture: PCS2b StateToPrefixBridge: shared source LayerNorm, shared 128-wide slice projection, flatten 18 slices, GELU MLP hidden=1024, four target-native prefix slots
bridge.objective: D1-b; 0.75 digit-restricted CE on (A parsed answer + m) mod base, 0.25 digit-restricted CE readback of A parsed answer; base100 targets use two zero-padded digits; no objective-correctness loss
bridge.selection: minimum validation D1-b loss; no held-out m in training or selection

bridge_config_source: PCS2b canonical architecture; no sealed W1_CHOICE.json is present in the checkout
claim: silent source cognition transfers through a continuous neural state and is used on a new step, including source mistakes

controls.oracle: P_B + Intermediate result: v = A parsed answer + explicit post-handoff query; P_B omits A's final question
controls.random_prefix: Gaussian prefix, rescaled per example to the L2 norm of the PCS prefix; seed 0
controls.text_handoff: identical user content and rendered chat prompt to B_restart; exact equality asserted
controls.token_identity_ceiling: deterministic one-hot-style answer computation from A parsed answer; descriptive upper bound, no receiver call
controls.wrong_states: 3 distinct test partners with a valid A answer different from current A answer; nearest source prompt token length, ties by episode index

criteria.silence_verified: 100% of included episodes have zero source answer tokens before the prompt checkpoint

d1_decision.basis: RESOLUTIONS_1_OPUS.md default D1-b; PCS4v3 RESULT records L3 not reached and available PCS4v4 reducer evidence is explicitly synthetic smoke, not reviewed scientific L3 evidence

gates: verified passing sealed RQ7 v2 choice and full raw/result/gate/protocol/code-sha chain
source digit-readout parse valid for at least 95% of records in each split
at least 400 parsed sealed test rows
at least 20 parsed source-wrong test episodes
invalid test source rows remain in evaluation denominators as failures
seal bridge sha and probe seed commitment before building wrong/random evaluation controls

interventions.test_schedule: one deterministic m from 1..4 and one from 5..9 per sealed source state
interventions.training_schedule: one training m per source state per epoch, cycling deterministically through 1..4; each state sees all four over each four epochs

prompt_amendment: RQ7 Amendment 1b; every B arm uses P_B (task statement without A's final question); restart and PCS arms state v explicitly before the future query

source.chat_template: Qwen apply_chat_template(enable_thinking=False); fixed answer anchor appended before the first answer digit
source.features: prompt-only last 2 answer-anchor token positions; layers 4,8,...,36 in layer-major then position order; no generated answer token enters features
source.generation: digit-restricted argmax; one digit for base 10 and two zero-padded digits for base 100; B_restart_reason is capped at 256 reasoning tokens before the anchored digit readout
source.prompt_user_content: P + newline + newline + base-specific numeric instruction; assistant turn is prefilled with newline + 'The answer is '.
source.silence_check: A has zero free generation tokens before its first answer digit by construction; source checkpoint is the final answer-anchor token

split.method: Random(20261010).shuffle(indexes); first 900 train, next 200 validation, remaining 500 sealed test

uncertainty.interval: percentile 95% cluster bootstrap over source episode ids
